directional_predictions.local_membership: Local membership should increase foothold renewal and downstream action persistence.
directional_predictions.embedded_infrastructure: Persistent local infrastructure should preserve knowledge/access after movement and increase foothold survival without directly creating fighters.
directional_predictions.target_knowledge: Target knowledge should increase execution conditional on local capacity, not create local organizational stock.
directional_predictions.logistics: Sustained logistics should increase realized action conditional on an opportunity, not substitute for local embeddedness.
directional_predictions.government_pressure: Higher government pressure should reduce execution probability and survival, with the sign estimated jointly rather than assumed to identify the bottleneck.

falsifiers: the local-foothold stock does not survive a matched movement when no current formation remains at the source
embedded infrastructure creates fighter equivalents without recruitment or fielded personnel
target knowledge changes action hazard before local capacity exists

any cell has source drift or a failed run manifest
